name: AppleFix
description: Fixes things that misbehave on macOS: trackpad scrolling no longer races across the hotbar, menus scroll with momentum again, Command + Q can drop a whole stack, and mods that open a file picker (like Scribble's book save and load buttons) no longer crash the game. Quitting the game no longer hangs for 15 seconds or shows a false crash report when a mod leaves background threads running, and leaving a world with Distant Horizons no longer freezes the game for seconds. Adds reverse scrolling and a scroll lock while attacking on every system.
